text:
amar: Heads-up — starting onboarding for model zeta-14b-v2 weights. HF path looks like: hf://redwood/zeta-14b-v2/commit/ab12f9d... I want to mirror to s3 for serving tests but seeing permission issues. Can infra help with ACL and checksum validation?

sophia: Which HF repo + commit? also do we have expected checksum from the registry?

amar: repo: https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-14b-v2 commit: ab12f9d... Manifest snippet shows sha256 in metadata. I'm pasting the s3 target we intend to use:

`````
s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-14b-v2/ab12f9d/weights.pt
`````

Expected digest from manifest: `sha256:6f3a9c4b2e1d8f3aa8c99d4b7f5e2c1a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8`

dennis: I can flip bucket ACLs, but first: are we using shadow-sync or origin-presign? If origin is HF we usually mirror via shadow-sync and verify checksums before promoting.

amar: preferring shadow-sync. I tried `rclone copy hf:... s3:...` and got 403 on s3 PUT. Also the checksum after a partial copy doesn't match.

jin: Can you paste the exact error and the output of `sha256sum weights.pt` on the node that pulled it from HF?

amar: Error: `upload failed: s3://.../weights.pt to s3/... 403 Forbidden`.

I don't have a local sha256 yet — the partial file has size 1.2GB but expected 6.2GB.

infra-bot: @dennis — bucket redwood-artifacts has a block public ACL policy. Grant needed: s3:PutObject for role `shadow-sync` on prefix `models/zeta-14b-v2/*`.

dennis: Granting PutObject for role shadow-sync on that prefix, and enabling kms:Encrypt if needed. will post policy in a sec.

registry-bot: Note: registry manifest id `zeta-14b-v2@ab12f9d` contains these artifacts:

`````
- weights: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-14b-v2/ab12f9d/weights.pt
  digest: sha256:6f3a9c4b2e1d8f3aa8c99d4b7f5e2c1a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8 (truncated)
- tokenizer: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-14b-v2/ab12f9d/tokenizer.json
  charset: utf-8
`````

sophia: Also note tokenizer on HF uses `tokenizer.json` but the tokenizer here was exported with legacy BPE merges. We need a quick smoke to validate token->id mapping. If mismatch we can get subtle decoding issues.

luca: Quick checklist: 1) mirror complete object 2) verify sha256 3) validate tokenizer roundtrip with small prompts 4) register artifact in registry with source=mirror.

amar: dennis — any ETA on ACL change? I can re-run mirror after that.

dennis: Done. policy applied at 1792000300. Try again.

amar: Re-run succeeded: upload completed. Local sha256: `6f3a9c4b2e1d8f3aa8c99d4b7f5e2c1a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8` matches registry digest. :tada: 

sophia: Great. Two followups: make sure the manifest `origin` field points to HF commit URL and `mirror` field points to s3 path. And add `tokenizer_format` = "hf-tokenizers-json" in manifest metadata.

amar: manifest updated and pushed to registry. snippet:

`````
{
  "id": "zeta-14b-v2@ab12f9d",
  "origin": "https://huggingface.co/redwood/zeta-14b-v2/commit/ab12f9d",
  "mirror": "s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-14b-v2/ab12f9d/",
  "artifacts": ["weights.pt","tokenizer.json"]
}
`````

jin: I'll run the tokenizer smoke: building vocab from tokenizer.json and running 10 short prompts.

jin: Smoke passed but found one tokenization edge: newline handling differs vs local test — adding a small normalization step in our tokenizer loader to trim leading U+00A0. I'll open a tiny PR.

amar: Thanks all — moving to serving readiness checklist. Next: config validation for batching profile and kv-cache setting. I'll ping eng-runtime separately.

sophia: Nice work. Closing this thread once runtime signoff done. :white_check_mark:
